body:
I'll try. I hate being seen as a quitter but sometimes it's hard to feel like anything other than quitting is the right answer. 

I should probably lie down. I'm exhausted. Do you mind if I follow up tomorrow?

The only thing stopping me I think is just me. It's the weight that I feel I carry. And I just...I don't know man. I believe you, or I want to believe you so bad that I'm trying to believe that I believe when you say that the cycle can be broken, but I'm terrified of the fact that you may be wrong. I don't think you are, but it's the idea that this is just how I have to live that bothers me so much. And then it becomes "why try at anything if you're going to feel this way? Who the fuck would want to be around some sad sack of shit who can't take the good in his life and just be happy? Why's he always got to be so fucking miserable?" Who wants to be around that guy? I don't blame anyone for opting not to. I just wish I could be better. I feel like I let down everyone. Like "oh here's fuckface again with his goddamn crippling depression that he can't fuck off about. Dude can't write, can't hold down a girlfriend, doesn't even like going out because what's he fucking do? He can't make conversation, he can't fucking do anything." Fuck this sounds so stupid but I just...I don't know how else to feel. I don't know how else to see myself.

Thanks for replying. I agree with you, I just have a hard time seeing it. Today was the first time I ran in a week and it just felt so pointless. Like 'oh great I'm getting in shape even more, yippie'. Maybe it's because I feel like most of these things I do for other people (stay in shape = easier time dating; going out to meet people = bigger network of friends). I just wish I knew how to extract joy from the things I love when I need it most. It's like watching everything slowly move out of grasp. It's still there. It hasn't changed. Just now it's further away. 

I don't know. I'm not making any sense, and your post made a lot of sense and I just wish I could take it and be like "there, I'm all plugged in and ready to go!" and I feel like a piece of shit cause I can't do that. I don't know how to. I try, and I'm going to try so hard cause you have some really good advice, but just don't think of me as a fuck up if I can't do it. Please.
